title: 03 Integrals: Visual Guide
outline: 1. Undo The Derivative | the bridge from the derivative rules you already have: a family of antiderivative curves with a draggable point and a draggable constant C, above the derivative curve whose height equals the tangent slope | F is an antiderivative of f exactly when F'(x) = f(x), and because a constant has zero derivative every f has a whole family F(x) + C

2. Rectangles To Area | four shapes crossed with the Left, Right, Midpoint and Trapezoidal rules and a slider for n, drawing the strips and reporting the signed error against the true area | left and right are decided by whether f rises or falls, trapezoidal and midpoint by which way f bends, and refining n shrinks the error without ever flipping its sign

3. Signed Area Ledger | a draggable upper limit b shading area green above the axis and red below, with the running integral shown beside the single subtraction F(b) - F(a) | the definite integral is signed area, the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus computes it as F(b) - F(a), and the integral from a to a is zero

4. The Antiderivative Table | an exponent slider running the Reverse Power Rule with the coefficient 1/(n+1) plotted as it blows up at n = -1, plus the four memorised entries for e^x, 1/x, sin and cos on a sign cycle | one mechanical rule covers every power except n = -1, where the formula divides by zero and ln|x| takes over

5. Chain Rule Backwards | six integrands stepped through choose-u, compute-du, rewrite, integrate and back-substitute, with a live numerical check comparing rectangles against F(b) - F(a) | u-substitution works only when the inner function's derivative is present as a factor, and stopping before back-substitution leaves an answer in a variable the question never asked about

6. Top Minus Bottom | the region between y = x and y = x^2 with a draggable right edge and a switch for splitting at the crossing point | area between curves is the integral of (top - bottom) split at every crossing, and refusing to split lets the pieces cancel until a real area reports itself as zero
